	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaComisiones")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewCliCobrador","Tg_ViewCliCobrador")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCobradores","Tg_Tabla","Cobradores","Clave")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCliCobrador.Alias
		
		thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		
		
		thisform.tg_cmbCobradores1.IrPrimero
		thisform.oTblCobradores.Buscar(thisform.tg_cmbCobradores1.Value)
		thisform.oLblComiGral.Caption=alltrim(Str(thisform.oTblCobradores.Leer("Comision"),6,2))
		
		
		thisform.tg_cmbCategorias1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbProvincias1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbZonas1.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.tg_cmbCategorias1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbProvincias1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbZonas1.Value="TD"
		
		
		thisform.OldId_Cobrador=thisform.Tg_CmbCobradores1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Provincia=thisform.Tg_CmbProvincias1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Zona=thisform.Tg_CmbZonas1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Categoria=thisform.Tg_CmbCategorias1.Value
		thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde=Space(5)
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta=Space(5)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcliente
		Local oAbmGen
		
		oAbmGen=CreateObject("tg_FormConsulta","Clientes",.f.,thisform.oViewCliCobrador.Leer("Id_cliente"))
		oAbmGen.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewCliCobrador.Refrescar(thisform.Tg_CmbCobradores1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbProvincias1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbZonas1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbCategorias1.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCliCobrador.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCliCobrador.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCliCobrador.Alias+".Id_Cliente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCliCobrador.Alias+".Razon_Social"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxclienteDesde.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde=this.Value
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value=this.Value
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxclienteHasta.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcategorias1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Categoria
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Categoria=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcobradores1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.oTblCobradores.Buscar(this.Value)
		thisform.oLblComiGral.Caption=alltrim(Str(thisform.oTblCobradores.Leer("Comision"),6,2))
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Cobrador
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Cobrador=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbprovincias1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Provincia
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Provincia=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbzonas1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Zona
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Zona=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarCliente
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaComisiones")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantesCobradores","Tg_ViewComprobantesCobradores")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Alias
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbCobradores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbCobradores1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Cobrador=thisform.Tg_CmbCobradores1.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompCobradores",thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarCompCobradores(thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Leer("Id_sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal,cId_Cobradores,lAnulado
		
		Thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal=""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		Endif
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbCobradores1.Value="TD"
			cId_Cobrador=""
		Else
			cId_Cobrador=ThisForm.Tg_cmbCobradores1.Value
		Endif
		
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCobradores1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,cId_Sucursal,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_Cobrador,lAnulado,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		
		Thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Alias+".NombreSistema"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Alias+".Total"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Alias+".NombreCobrador"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Alias+".Detalle"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Alias+".Comision"
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oViewComprobantesCobradores.Sumar("iif(Suma,1,-1)*Total",".t."),2)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oOpgAnulado.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.F.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcobradores1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Cobrador
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Cobrador=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbsucursales1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Sucursal
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
				ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescobradores1.Init
		dodefault(".t.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescobradores1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1' AS tg_seleccionarcomprobantes WITH ;
		Height = 135, ;

		Name = "Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1", ;

		Tg_label2.Name = "Tg_label2", ;

		Tg_label1.Name = "Tg_label1", ;
		Tg_label1.Top = 3, ;
		Tg_label1.ZOrderSet = 3, ;
		Tg_cmbgrupossucur1.Name = "Tg_cmbgrupossucur1"
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_varios.vcx" BaseClass="container" />
	
	PROCEDURE consultardiaspromediocobranza
		lParameters cId_Sucursal, cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba, nNro_Referencia
		
		Local nDiasPromedio, vDatos, vCompImnputados, nCantCompImputados
		Local cId_Suc_Cruce,cId_Sis_Cruce,cId_Com_Cruce,nNro_Cruce
		Local cId_Mon_Deuda,dFechaRecibo,cId_Mon_Valor
		Local nTotalCreditos,nTotalCobranzas,cComprobante,nPorcentaje,nImporteCuota,nMontoValorConvertido
		Local nMontoAlDia, nMontoValor, dVenciValor
		Local nMultiplicador,nCobradoTotal
		
		Dimension vDatos[1,2]
		Dimension vCompImputados[1,2]
		
		nDiasPromedio = 0
		nCantCompImputados = 0
		
		Thisform.onoaux_venci.Revertir()
		Thisform.oAux_VenciRecibos.Revertir()
		Thisform.oAux_VenciFinal.Revertir()
		
		* Primero busco el recibo en imputaciones 
		
		if Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nNro_Referencia,10),.f.,"Clave")
		
		   Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nNro_Referencia,10),.f.,"Clave")
		   cId_Mon_Deuda = Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Mon_Deuda")
		   dFechaRecibo  = Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha")
		
		   Do While !Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.EsEof() and Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Sucursal")=cId_Sucursal ;
		                                              and Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Sistema")=cId_Sistema ;   
		                                              and Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Comproba")=cId_Comproba ;
		                                              and Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Nro_Referencia")=nNro_Referencia
		                                                    
		      if !Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Pendiente")                                               
		            
		         cId_Suc_Cruce = Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Suc_Cruce")
		         cId_Sis_Cruce = Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Sis_Cruce")
		         cId_Com_Cruce = Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Com_Cruce")
		         nNro_Cruce    = Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Nro_Cruce")
		         
		         nCantCompImputados = nCantCompImputados + 1
		         
		         Dimension vCompImputados[nCantCompImputados,2]
		         
		         vCompImputados[nCantCompImputados,1] = cId_Suc_Cruce+cId_Sis_Cruce+cId_Com_Cruce+str(nNro_Cruce,10)
		         vCompImputados[nCantCompImputados,2] = 0
		                     
		         Thisform.oVnt_Vencimientos.Buscar(cId_Suc_Cruce+cId_Sis_Cruce+cId_Com_Cruce+str(nNro_Cruce,10),.f.,"Clave")
		          
		         Do While !Thisform.oVnt_Vencimientos.EsEof() and Thisform.oVnt_Vencimientos.Leer("Id_Sucursal")=cId_Suc_Cruce ;
		                                                      and Thisform.oVnt_Vencimientos.Leer("Id_Sistema")=cId_Sis_Cruce ;   
		                                                      and Thisform.oVnt_Vencimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba")=cId_Com_Cruce ;
		                                                      and Thisform.oVnt_Vencimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia")=nNro_Cruce              
		                 
		            vCompImputados[nCantCompImputados,2] = vCompImputados[nCantCompImputados,2] + 1
		            
		            =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Sucursal"     , cId_Suc_Cruce )
		            =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Sistema"      , cId_Sis_Cruce )      
		            =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Comproba"     , cId_Com_Cruce )      
		            =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Nro_Referencia"  , nNro_Cruce )            
		            =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Fecha_Venc"      , Thisform.oVnt_Vencimientos.Leer("Fecha_Venc"))            
		            =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Porcentaje"      , Thisform.oVnt_Vencimientos.Leer("Porcentaje"))            
		            =fGrabar(@vDatos , "ImporteCuota"    , Thisform.oVnt_Vencimientos.Leer("ImporteCuota"))            
		                                                                              
		            Thisform.onoaux_venci.AgregarYModificar(@vDAtos,.t.)                                          
		              
		            Thisform.oVnt_Vencimientos.IrSiguiente()
		               
		         Enddo      
		         
		      Endif   
		         
		      Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.IrSiguiente()   
		      
		   enddo
		   
		   * ahora tengo que ver si las imputaciones tienen cobranzas anteriores o notas de credito
		   * para bajar el importe de cuota que imputara este recibo al distribuir los valores
		   * el importe de cuota lo debere bajar del onoaux_venci Luego y si hay notas de credito proporcionalmente en cada
		   * cuota y si hay recibos ir cancelando hasta quedarme sin inmporte
		      
		   if nCantCompImputados <> 0 
		      
		   for i = 1 to alen(vCompImputados,1)
		     
		       nTotalCreditos = 0
		       nTotalCobranzas = 0
		     
		       Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Buscar(vCompImputados[i,1] ,.f.,"Clave")           
		   
		       Do While !Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.EsEof() and Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+;
		                                                      Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Sistema")+;   
		                                                      Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Comproba")+;
		                                                      str(Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)=;              
		                                                      vCompImputados[i,1]
		         
		          if !Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Pendiente")                                               
		             
		             cId_Suc_Cruce = Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Suc_Cruce")
		             cId_Sis_Cruce = Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Sis_Cruce")
		             cId_Com_Cruce = Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Com_Cruce")
		             nNro_Cruce    = Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Nro_Cruce")
		             
		             * pregunto que la imputacion no sea el recibo que analizo
		             
		             if (cId_Suc_Cruce+cId_Sis_Cruce+cId_Com_Cruce+Str(nNro_Cruce,10))<>(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nNro_Referencia,10))
		             
		                Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(cId_Suc_Cruce+cId_Sis_Cruce+cId_Com_Cruce+str(nNro_Cruce,10),.f.,"Clave")
		          
		                * tengo que ver que las imputaciones sean con fecha menor a la cobranza para descontarle el inmporta
		                * a los vencimientos
		          
		                if Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha") <= dFechaRecibo 
		             
		                   if Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Cobranza")
		                      nTotalCobranzas = nTotalCobranzas + Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Importe")                                               
		                   else
		                      nTotalCreditos = nTotalCreditos + Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Importe")                                               
		                   endif
		                
		                endif
		          
		             endif
		             
		          endif
		          
		          Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.IrSiguiente()
		          
		       Enddo
		       
		       * hasta aca tengo cuanto cobrado por recibos y cuanto por creditos tiene el comprobante imputado
		       * o sea que esos importes tengo que distribuirlos en los vencimientos del comprobante en onoaux_venci
		       
		       * primero distribuyo los creditos que se hace en forma proporcional
		       if nTotalCreditos <> 0 
		       
		          Thisform.onoaux_venci.IrPrimero()
		          
		          Do while !Thisform.onoaux_venci.EsEof()
		             
		             cComprobante = Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Sistema")+Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Comproba")+str(Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)
		             
		             if cComprobante = vCompImputados[i,1]
		             
		                nPorcentaje = Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Porcentaje")
		                nImporteCuota = Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("ImporteCuota")
		                nImporteCuota = nImporteCuota - ( nTotalCreditos * nPorcentaje /100 )
		                
		                =fGrabar(@vDatos , "ImporteCuota"    , nImporteCuota )
		                                            
		                Thisform.onoaux_venci.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)                                          
		                
		             endif
		             
		             Thisform.onoaux_venci.IrSiguiente()
		             
		          enddo
		           
		       endif
		       
		       * ahora distribuyo la cobranza que haya tenido el comprobante imputado
		       
		       if nTotalCobranzas <> 0
		       
		          Thisform.onoaux_venci.IrPrimero()
		          
		          Do while !Thisform.onoaux_venci.EsEof()
		             
		             cComprobante = Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Sistema")+Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Comproba")+str(Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)
		             
		             if cComprobante = vCompImputados[i,1]
		             
		                nImporteCuota = Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("ImporteCuota")
		                
		                if nTotalCobranzas >= nImporteCuota
		                   nTotalCobranzas = nTotalCobranzas - nImporteCuota
		                   nImporteCuota = 0
		                else
		                   nImporteCuota = nImporteCuota - nTotalCobranzas
		                   nTotalCobranzas = 0
		                endif   
		                
		                =fGrabar(@vDatos , "ImporteCuota"    , nImporteCuota )
		                                            
		                Thisform.onoaux_venci.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)                                          
		                
		             endif
		             
		             Thisform.onoaux_venci.IrSiguiente()
		             
		          enddo
		       
		       endif
		       
		   next
		
		   * ahora borro todos los registros que hayan quedado con cuota cero
		
		*!*	   Thisform.onoaux_venci.IrPrimero()
		*!*	   Do while !Thisform.onoaux_venci.EsEof()
		*!*	      if Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("ImporteCuota")=0
		*!*	         Thisform.onoaux_venci.Borrar()
		*!*	      endif
		*!*	      Thisform.onoaux_venci.IrSiguiente()
		*!*	   enddo
		   
		   * ahora cargo los vencimientos de los valores del recibo   
		         
		   Thisform.oVnt_DetCob.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nNro_Referencia,10),.f.,"Clave")         
		   
		   Do While !Thisform.oVnt_DetCob.EsEof() and Thisform.oVnt_DetCob.Leer("Id_Sucursal")=cId_Sucursal ;
		                                         and Thisform.oVnt_DetCob.Leer("Id_Sistema")=cId_Sistema ;   
		                                         and Thisform.oVnt_DetCob.Leer("Id_Comproba")=cId_Comproba ;
		                                         and Thisform.oVnt_DetCob.Leer("Nro_Referencia")=nNro_Referencia
		            
		      =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Sucursal"     , cId_Sucursal )
		      =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Sistema"      , cId_Sistema )      
		      =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Comproba"     , cId_Comproba )      
		      =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Nro_Referencia"  , nNro_Referencia )            
		      
		      if Thisform.oVnt_DetCob.Leer("Fecha_Venc") = ctod("  /  /  ")
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Fecha_Venc"      , dFechaRecibo )            
		      else   
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Fecha_Venc"      , Thisform.oVnt_DetCob.Leer("Fecha_Venc"))            
		      endif
		         
		      cId_Mon_Valor = Thisform.oVnt_DetCob.Leer("Id_Moneda")   
		      
		      if cId_Mon_Valor = cId_Mon_Deuda
		         if Thisform.oVnt_DetCob.Leer("Ingreso")
		            =fGrabar(@vDatos , "ImporteCuota"      , Thisform.oVnt_DetCob.Leer("Monto"))                   
		         else
		            =fGrabar(@vDatos , "ImporteCuota"      , Thisform.oVnt_DetCob.Leer("Monto")*(-1))                                  
		         endif
		      else      
		      
		         nMontoValorConvertido = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(Thisform.oVnt_DetCob.Leer("Monto"),cId_Mon_Deuda,0,cId_Mon_Valor,0,dFechaRecibo)      
		         
		         if Thisform.oVnt_DetCob.Leer("Ingreso")
		            =fGrabar(@vDatos , "ImporteCuota"      , nMontoValorConvertido)                   
		         else
		            =fGrabar(@vDatos , "ImporteCuota"      , nMontoValorConvertido * (-1))                                  
		         endif
		         
		      endif
		                                                                              
		      Thisform.oAux_VenciRecibos.AgregarYModificar(@vDAtos,.t.)                                          
		              
		      Thisform.oVnt_DetCob.IrSiguiente()
		      
		   Enddo      
		
		   * ahora barro el archivo resultante del recibo sacando el monto al dia cobrado con el recibo y borrando los registros 
		   * correspondientes        
		      
		   nMontoAlDia = 0   
		         
		   Thisform.oAux_VenciRecibos.IrPrimero()
		
		   Do while !Thisform.oAux_VenciRecibos.EsEof() and Thisform.oAux_VenciRecibos.Leer("Fecha_Venc")=dFechaRecibo
		      nMontoAlDia = nMontoAlDia + Thisform.oAux_VenciRecibos.Leer("ImporteCuota")   
		      Thisform.oAux_VenciRecibos.IrSiguiente()
		   Enddo
		   
		   * ahora barro los vencimientos de factura asignando los vencimientos de valores de recibo
		   * y grabo el archivo definitivo
		   
		   Thisform.onoaux_venci.IrPrimero()
		   
		   Do while !Thisform.onoaux_venci.EsEof()
		   
		      if Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("ImporteCuota") <> 0  
		   
		         nImporteCuota = Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("ImporteCuota")
		      
		         if nMontoAlDia < nImporteCuota and nMontoAlDia <> 0
		      
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Sucursal"     , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Sucursal") )
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Sistema"      , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Sistema") )      
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Comproba"     , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Comproba") )      
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Nro_Referencia"  , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Nro_Referencia") )            
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Fecha_Venc"      , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Fecha_Venc"))
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Fecha_Venccash"  , dFechaRecibo )
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "ImporteCuota"    , nMontoAlDia )            
		                                                                              
		         Thisform.oAux_VenciFinal.AgregarYModificar(@vDAtos,.t.)
		         
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "ImporteCuota"    , nImporteCuota - nMontoAlDia )            
		         
		         Thisform.onoaux_venci.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
		         
		         nImporteCuota = Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("ImporteCuota")
		         
		         nMontoAlDia = 0                                          
		             
		         endif
		      
		         if nMontoAlDia >= nImporteCuota and nMontoAlDia <> 0
		            
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Sucursal"     , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Sucursal") )
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Sistema"      , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Sistema") )      
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Comproba"     , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Comproba") )      
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Nro_Referencia"  , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Nro_Referencia") )            
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Fecha_Venc"      , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Fecha_Venc"))
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Fecha_Venccash"  , dFechaRecibo )
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "ImporteCuota"    , nImporteCuota )            
		                                                                              
		         Thisform.oAux_VenciFinal.AgregarYModificar(@vDAtos,.t.)
		         
		         nMontoAlDia = nMontoAlDia - nImporteCuota
		      
		         if !Thisform.onoaux_venci.EsEof()
		            Thisform.onoaux_venci.IrSiguiente()
		         else
		            exit 
		         endif
		         
		         endif
		   
		         if nMontoAlDia = 0 and !Thisform.oAux_VenciRecibos.EsEof()   && empiezo a repartir los valores con vencimiento
		      
		            nMontoValor = Thisform.oAux_VenciRecibos.Leer("ImporteCuota")   
		            dVenciValor = Thisform.oAux_VenciRecibos.Leer("Fecha_Venc")   
		         
		            if nMontoValor < nImporteCuota 
		      
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Sucursal"     , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Sucursal") )
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Sistema"      , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Sistema") )      
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Comproba"     , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Comproba") )      
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Nro_Referencia"  , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Nro_Referencia") )            
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Fecha_Venc"      , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Fecha_Venc"))
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Fecha_Venccash"  , dVenciValor )
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "ImporteCuota"    , nMontoValor )            
		                                                                              
		               Thisform.oAux_VenciFinal.AgregarYModificar(@vDAtos,.t.)
		         
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "ImporteCuota"    , nImporteCuota - nMontoValor )            
		         
		               Thisform.onoaux_venci.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
		         
		               nImporteCuota = Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("ImporteCuota")
		         
		               nMontoValor = 0                                          
		            
		               if !Thisform.oAux_VenciRecibos.EsEof()
		                  Thisform.oAux_VenciRecibos.IrSiguiente()         
		               endif   
		            
		            endif
		         
		            if nMontoValor >= nImporteCuota
		            
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Sucursal"     , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Sucursal") )
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Sistema"      , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Sistema") )      
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Comproba"     , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Id_Comproba") )      
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Nro_Referencia"  , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Nro_Referencia") )            
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Fecha_Venc"      , Thisform.onoaux_venci.Leer("Fecha_Venc"))
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Fecha_Venccash"  , dVenciValor )
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "ImporteCuota"    , nImporteCuota )            
		                                                                              
		               Thisform.oAux_VenciFinal.AgregarYModificar(@vDAtos,.t.)
		         
		               nMontoValor = nMontoValor - nImporteCuota
		                   
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "ImporteCuota"    , nMontoValor )            
		      
		               Thisform.oAux_VenciRecibos.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
		      
		               if !Thisform.onoaux_venci.EsEof() 
		                  Thisform.onoaux_venci.IrSiguiente()
		               else
		                  exit
		               endif      
		         
		            endif
		               
		         endif
		         
		         if nMontoAlDia = 0 and Thisform.oAux_VenciRecibos.EsEof()
		            exit
		         endif   
		         
		      else
		      
		         Thisform.onoaux_venci.IrSiguiente()
		         
		      endif
		      
		   enddo
		   
		   Thisform.oAux_VenciFinal.IrPrimero()
		   
		   nMultiplicador = 0
		   nCobradoTotal = 0
		   
		   Do while !Thisform.oAux_VenciFinal.EsEof()
		      nMultiplicador = nMultiplicador + ((Thisform.oAux_VenciFinal.Leer("Fecha_VencCash") - Thisform.oAux_VenciFinal.Leer("Fecha_Venc")) * Thisform.oAux_VenciFinal.Leer("ImporteCuota"))
		      nCobradoTotal  = nCobradoTotal + Thisform.oAux_VenciFinal.Leer("ImporteCuota")    
		      Thisform.oAux_VenciFinal.IrSiguiente()  
		   Enddo
		
		   if nCobradoTotal<>0
		   
		      nDiasPromedio = nMultiplicador / nCobradoTotal
		      
		   endif
		  
		   endif  
		   
		endif         
		         
		return nDiasPromedio
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimir
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias
		
		If nCopias>0 
			thisform.ImprimirComprobante(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias)
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimirlotes
		Local vDatos[1,2],nCopias
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			If  thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Imprime")
				Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
				
				if !thisform.oChkAsignaCopias.Value
					nCopias = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Copias")
				else
					nCopias = Thisform.Tg_Spinner1.Value
				endif
				
				If nCopias=0
					nCopias = 1
				Endif
				Thisform.Imprimir(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),nCopias )	
			Endif
				
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantes","Tg_ViewComprobantes")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu","tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oAux_Liq","tg_tabla","Aux_LiqComiCobrador","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha","tg_tabla","Aux_LiqComiCobrador","Fecha")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Cabecera","tg_tabla","Vnt_Cabecera","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCobradores","tg_tabla","Cobradores","clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oVnt_Imputacion","tg_tabla","Vnt_Imputacion","Clave")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oVnt_DetCob","tg_tabla","Vnt_DetCob","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oVnt_Vencimientos","tg_tabla","Vnt_Vencimientos","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("onoaux_venci","tg_tabla","Aux_NoVenci","Fecha_Venc")
		Thisform.AddObject("oAux_VenciRecibos","tg_tabla","Aux_NoVenci","Fecha_Venc")
		Thisform.AddObject("oAux_VenciFinal","tg_tabla","Aux_NoVenci")
		Thisform.onoaux_venci.SetearProp("BOT")
		Thisform.oAux_VenciRecibos.SetearProp("BOT")
		Thisform.oAux_VenciFinal.SetearProp("BOT")
		
		Thisform.oAux_Liq.SetearProp("BOT")
		Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.SetearProp("BOT")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oCstSistemaVentas","Tg_SistemaVentas")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oCstConvMonUniversal","Tg_ConvMonUniversal")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		thisform.tg_cmbCobradores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbCobradores1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbGruposEmpresarios1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbGruposEmpresarios1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbCategorias1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbCategorias1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbGrupoClientes11.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbGrupoClientes11.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbGrupoClientes21.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbGrupoClientes21.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbGrupoClientes31.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbGrupoClientes31.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbGrupoClientes41.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbGrupoClientes41.Value="TD"
		Thisform.tg_Clientes1.Value = space(5)
		
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde     = Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta     = Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		
		thisform.OldId_moneda      = thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion = thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		Thisform.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Color")="R"
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
		Endif
		
		If thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Color")="F"
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oAux_Liq.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal,cId_vendedor,lAnulado, cId_EstadoComproba, cId_Cliente
		Local cClave, vDatos, cId_cobrador, dFecha
		Local cNombre,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_referencia,cNro_Externo,nImporte,cId_Moneda,cTipoCotizacion
		Local cId_Mon_Deuda,nTotalDeuda,nTotal,nPorcentaje,lSinImputacion
		Local cId_Suc_Cruce,cId_Sis_Cruce,cId_Com_Cruce,nNro_Cruce, nTotalImputado
		Local nDiasPromedio,nCobranzaBrutaTotal,nCobranzaporDiasPromedioTotal,nComisionesTotal
		Local nPendienteImputacion,nPorcentajeImputacion
		
		Dimension vDatos[1,2]
		
		cId_Sucursal=""
		cId_Vendedor=""
		cId_EstadoComproba=""
		
		if alltrim(thisform.Tg_Clientes1.Value) = ""
		   cId_cliente=""
		else
		   cId_cliente=thisform.Tg_Clientes1.Value
		endif 
		
		cId_Moneda = thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		cTipoCotizacion = thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion() && 1 historica 2 actual
		
		lAnulado=.f.
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		
		Thisform.oAux_Liq.Revertir()
		Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.Revertir()
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,cId_Cliente,cId_Sucursal,cId_vendedor,;
											 ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,;
											 ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),lAnulado,;
											 ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),;
											 ctod("  /  /  "),ctod("  /  /  "),;
											 .f.,cId_EstadoComproba)
											 
		Thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		do while !Thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
		   Thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(Thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Cliente"),.f.,"Clave")
		   
		   cClave=Thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+Thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema")+Thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba")+str(Thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)
		   
		   Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(cClave,.f.,"Clave")
		   
		   cId_Cobrador = Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Cobrador")
		   
		   dFecha       = Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha")
		   
		   if (Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Categoria")=Thisform.Tg_CmbCategorias1.Value or Thisform.Tg_CmbCategorias1.Value="TD") and ;
		      (Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_GrupoEmpresario")=Thisform.Tg_CmbGruposEmpresarios1.Value or Thisform.Tg_CmbGruposEmpresarios1.Value="TD") and ;
		      (Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_GrupoClientes1")=Thisform.Tg_CmbGrupoClientes11.Value or Thisform.Tg_CmbGrupoClientes11.Value="TD") and ;
		      (Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_GrupoClientes2")=Thisform.Tg_CmbGrupoClientes21.Value or Thisform.Tg_CmbGrupoClientes21.Value="TD") and ;       
		      (Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_GrupoClientes3")=Thisform.Tg_CmbGrupoClientes31.Value or Thisform.Tg_CmbGrupoClientes31.Value="TD") and ;             
		      (Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_GrupoClientes4")=Thisform.Tg_CmbGrupoClientes41.Value or Thisform.Tg_CmbGrupoClientes41.Value="TD") and ;             
		      (Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Cobrador")=Thisform.Tg_CmbCobradores1.Value or Thisform.Tg_CmbCobradores1.Value="TD")
		      
		      *nCostoArticuloFormula = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Costo"),cId_MonedaCostoArticuloFormula,0,cId_MonedaCostoArticulo,0,oApp.CargarFechaSistema())
		      
		      * aca veo el tema del total del recibo en moneda de presentacion
		      cId_Mon_Deuda = Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Mon_Deuda")
		      nTotalDeuda   = Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("TotalDeuda")
		      
		      nTotal = nTotalDeuda
		      
		      if cId_Moneda <> cId_Mon_Deuda
		         if cTipoCotizacion = 2
		            nTotal = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(nTotalDeuda,cId_Mon_Deuda,0,cId_Moneda,0,oApp.CargarFechaSistema())
		         else
		            nTotal = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(nTotalDeuda,cId_Mon_Deuda,0,cId_Moneda,0,dFecha)
		         endif   
		      endif 
		      
		   	  =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"Id_Cobrador"     , cId_Cobrador)
		   	  =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"Fecha"           , dFecha)
		   	  =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"Id_Sucursal"     , Thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"))
		   	  =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"Id_Sistema"      , Thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"))
		   	  =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"Id_Comproba"     , Thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"))   	     	  
		   	  =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"Nro_Referencia"  , Thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"))
		   	  =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"Nro_Externo"     , Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Externo"))
		   	  =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"Importe"         , nTotal)
		   	  =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"Id_Codigo"       , Thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Cliente"))
		   	  =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"Porcentaje"      , Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Comision_Cobrador"))
		  	     	     	     	  
		   	  Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.AgregarYModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		   endif
		   	
		   Thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		   
		Enddo
		
		Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.IrPrimero()
		
		Do while !Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.EsEof()
		
		   nCobranzaBrutaTotal = 0
		   nCobranzaporDiasPromedioTotal = 0
		   nComisionesTotal = 0 
		
		   cId_Cobrador =  Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.Leer("Id_Cobrador")
		   
		   Thisform.oTblCobradores.Buscar(cId_Cobrador,.f.,"Clave")
		   
		   =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"Id_Cobrador"     , cId_Cobrador)
		   =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"Id_Codigo"       , cId_Cobrador)
		   =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"Nombre"          , Thisform.oTblCobradores.leer("Nombre"))
		   =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"Color"           , "C")
		   Thisform.oAux_Liq.AgregarYModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		   =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"Id_Cobrador"     , cId_Cobrador)
		   =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"Id_Codigo"       , space(5))
		   Thisform.oAux_Liq.AgregarYModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		   
		   Do while !Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.EsEof() and Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.Leer("Id_Cobrador")=cId_Cobrador
		   
		      cId_cliente     = Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.Leer("Id_Codigo")
		      
		      Thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(cId_Cliente,.f.,"Clave")
		      
		      cNombre         = Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social")
		      dFecha          = Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.Leer("Fecha")
		      cId_Sucursal    = Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
		      cId_Sistema     = Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.Leer("Id_Sistema")      
		      cId_Comproba    = Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.Leer("Id_Comproba")      
		      nNro_referencia = Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.Leer("Nro_Referencia")      
		      cNro_Externo    = Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.Leer("Nro_Externo")       
		      nImporte        = Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.Leer("Importe")       
		      nPorcentaje     = Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.Leer("Porcentaje")       
		  	  *nDiasPromedio   = Thisform.oCstSistemaVentas.ConsultarDiasPromedioCobranza(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia)
		  	  nDiasPromedio   = Thisform.ConsultarDiasPromedioCobranza(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia)  	  
		  	  
		  	  if nDiasPromedio < (-99)
		  	     nDiasPromedio = -99
		  	  endif   
		  	  if nDiasPromedio > 999
		  	     nDiasPromedio = 999
		  	  endif
		  	     
		      =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Cobrador"     , cId_Cobrador )
		      =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Codigo"       , cId_Cliente )
		      =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Nombre"          , cNombre )
		      =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Fecha"           , dFecha )
		      =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Sucursal"     , cId_Sucursal )
		      =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Sistema"      , cId_Sistema )      
		      =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Comproba"     , cId_Comproba )      
		      =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Nro_Referencia"  , nNro_Referencia )            
		      =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Nro_Externo"     , cNro_Externo )                  
		      =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Importe"         , nImporte )                  
		      =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Color"           , "R" )
		   	  =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"DiasPromedio"    , nDiasPromedio )
		   	        
		      Thisform.oAux_Liq.AgregarYModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		      
		      nCobranzaBrutaTotal = nCobranzaBrutaTotal + nImporte
		      nCobranzaporDiasPromedioTotal = nCobranzaporDiasPromedioTotal + (nImporte * nDiasPromedio)
		      
		      * aca agrego las imputaciones del comprobante
		      
		      lSinImputacion = .t.
		      nPendienteImputacion = 0
		      
		      if Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nNro_Referencia,10),.f.,"Clave")
		      
		         Do While !Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.EsEof() and Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Sucursal")=cId_Sucursal ;
		                                                    and Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Sistema")=cId_Sistema ;   
		                                                    and Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Comproba")=cId_Comproba ;
		                                                    and Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Nro_Referencia")=nNro_Referencia
		                                                    
		            if !Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Pendiente")                                               
		            
		               lSinImputacion = .f.
		               
		               cId_Suc_Cruce = Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Suc_Cruce")
		               cId_Sis_Cruce = Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Sis_Cruce")
		               cId_Com_Cruce = Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Com_Cruce")
		               nNro_Cruce    = Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Nro_Cruce")
		               nTotalImputado = Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Importe")
		               
		               Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(cId_Suc_Cruce+cId_Sis_Cruce+cId_Com_Cruce+str(nNro_Cruce,10),.f.,"Clave")
		               
		               * porcentajes de iva de la factura
		               
		               nIva = Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Porc_Iva1") + Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Porc_Iva2")               
		               
		               * aca veo el tema del total del recibo en moneda de presentacion
		               cId_Mon_Deuda = Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Mon_Deuda")
		               nTotalDeuda   = Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("TotalDeuda")
		      
		               nTotal = nTotalDeuda
		      
		               if cId_Moneda <> cId_Mon_Deuda
		                  if cTipoCotizacion = 2
		                     nTotal = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(nTotalDeuda,cId_Mon_Deuda,0,cId_Moneda,0,oApp.CargarFechaSistema())
		                     nTotalImputado = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(nTotalImputado,cId_Mon_Deuda,0,cId_Moneda,0,oApp.CargarFechaSistema())
		                  else
		                     nTotal = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(nTotalDeuda,cId_Mon_Deuda,0,cId_Moneda,0,Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha"))
		                     nTotalImputado = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(nTotalImputado,cId_Mon_Deuda,0,cId_Moneda,0,Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha"))
		                  endif   
		               endif 
		               
		               nTotalImputado = nTotalImputado / ( 1 + (nIva/100))
		               
		               nPorcentajeImputacion=iif(Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Comision_Cobrador")=0,nPorcentaje,Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Comision_Cobrador"))
		               
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Cobrador"     , cId_Cobrador )
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Codigo"       , Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Cliente"))
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Nombre"          , Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nombre"))
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Fecha"           , Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha"))
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Sucursal"     , cId_Suc_Cruce )
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Sistema"      , cId_Sis_Cruce )      
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Comproba"     , cId_Com_Cruce )      
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Nro_Referencia"  , nNro_Cruce )            
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Nro_Externo"     , Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Externo") )                  
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Importe"         , nTotal )                  
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Porcentaje"      , nPorcentajeImputacion )
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "NetoCob"         , nTotalImputado )
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Comision"        , nTotalImputado * nPorcentajeImputacion / 100 )
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Color"           , "F" )               
		   	        
		               Thisform.oAux_Liq.AgregarYModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		               
		               nComisionesTotal = nComisionesTotal + (nTotalImputado * nPorcentajeImputacion / 100)
		            
		            else && tiene algo pendiente el recibo
		               nPendienteImputacion = Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Importe")          
		            endif
		                                                    
		            Thisform.oVnt_Imputacion.IrSiguiente()
		            
		         Enddo                                           
		         
		         if lSinImputacion
		            =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Cobrador"     , cId_Cobrador )
		            =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Codigo"       , space(5))
		            =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Nombre"          , "Recibo sin Imputaciones")
		            Thisform.oAux_Liq.AgregarYModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		         else
		            if nPendienteImputacion <> 0
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Cobrador"     , cId_Cobrador )
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Codigo"       , space(5))
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Nombre"          , "Pendiente de Imputacion")
		               =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Importe"         , nPendienteImputacion )                  
		               *=fGrabar(@vDatos , "Porcentaje"      , nPorcentaje )
		               *=fGrabar(@vDatos , "NetoCob"         , nPendienteImputacion )
		               *=fGrabar(@vDatos , "Comision"        , nTotalImputado * nPorcentaje / 100 )
		               
		               Thisform.oAux_Liq.AgregarYModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		            endif
		         endif            
		         
		         * dejo renglon en blanco entre recibo y recibo
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Cobrador"     , cId_Cobrador )
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Codigo"       , space(5))
		         Thisform.oAux_Liq.AgregarYModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		         
		         
		      endif
		      
		      Thisform.oAux_LiqComiCobradorFecha.IrSiguiente()
		      
		   Enddo 
		
		   =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Cobrador"     , cId_Cobrador )
		   =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Codigo"       , space(5))
		   =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Nombre"          , "Totales Cobrador")
		   =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Comision"        , nComisionesTotal )   
		   =fGrabar(@vDatos ,"DiasPromedio"     , nCobranzaporDiasPromedioTotal / nCobranzaBrutaTotal )   
		   Thisform.oAux_Liq.AgregarYModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		   =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Cobrador"     , cId_Cobrador )
		   =fGrabar(@vDatos , "Id_Codigo"       , space(5))
		   Thisform.oAux_Liq.AgregarYModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		   
		Enddo
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		Local cStringColor
		
		Thisform.oAux_Liq.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oAux_Liq.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource =thisform.oAux_Liq.Alias+".Id_Codigo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource =thisform.oAux_Liq.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource =thisform.oAux_Liq.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource =thisform.oAux_Liq.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource =thisform.oAux_Liq.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource =thisform.oAux_Liq.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource =thisform.oAux_Liq.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource =thisform.oAux_Liq.Alias+".Importe"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource =thisform.oAux_Liq.Alias+".NetoCob"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_Liq.Alias+".Porcentaje"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_Liq.Alias+".Comision"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column12.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_Liq.Alias+".DiasPromedio"
		
		*cStringcolor = 'Iif(thisForm.oAux_Liq.Leer("Color")="C",rgb(128,255,255),iif(thisForm.oAux_Liq.Leer("Color")="R",rgb(255,255,128),""))'
		*cStringcolor = 'Iif(thisForm.oAux_Liq.Leer("Color")="C",rgb(128,255,255),"")'
		
		*for mmpp = 1 to thisform.tg_grid1.Columncount
		*    thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicBackColor = cStringcolor
		*endfor    
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionar
		Local vDatos[1,2],lImprime
		
		If Alltrim(Upper(ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption))="NINGUNO"
			lImprime = .f.
		Else
			lImprime = .t.
		Endif
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Imprime",lImprime)
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EnDDo
		
		If lImprime 
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Ninguno"
		Else
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Seleccionar todo"
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		this.Enabled=.f.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		if this.value = ctod("  /  /  ")
		   ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .f.
		else 
		   ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .t.
		endif
		      
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
			ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.Valid
		LPARAMETERS lanulamensaje
		
		if alltrim(this.Value)=""
		   ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		   ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		   return .t.
		endif
		
		if Thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(This.Value,.f.,"Clave")   
		   ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		   ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		   return .t.
		endif
		
		return .t.   
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcategorias1.InteractiveChange
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
				ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcobradores1.InteractiveChange

	ENDPROC

				ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
				ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Init
		dodefault("Cobranza=.t. and suma=.f.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaComisiones")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewSaldosCobradores","Tg_ViewSaldosCobradores")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewSaldosCobradores.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcuentacorriente
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCuentaCorriente","TG_CtaCorrienteCobradores",thisform.oViewSaldosCobradores.Leer("Id_Cobrador"))				
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaCuentaCorriente.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewSaldosCobradores.Refrescar()
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewSaldosCobradores.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewSaldosCobradores.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosCobradores.Alias+".Id_Cobrador"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosCobradores.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosCobradores.Alias+".Saldo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosCobradores.Alias+".NombreMoneda"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

		thisform.MostrarCuentaCorriente
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Cobrador
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaComisiones")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores","Tg_ViewCtaCorrienteCobradores")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCobradores","tg_tabla","Cobradores","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbcobradores1.IrPrimero
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Alias
		
		thisform.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(6,7,8,9)
		
		If Type("cId_Cobrador")<>T_LOGICAL
			thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
			thisform.tg_CmbCobradores1.Value=cId_Cobrador
			thisform.tg_CmbCobradores1.Enabled=.f.
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.	
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.	
			thisform.RefrescarConsulta(.t.)
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompCobradores",thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarCompCobradores(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Leer("Id_sistema"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta(.f.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters lMoverFocus
		Local lComiFacturacion
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_CmbCobradores1.Value,ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Alias
				
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla(lMoverFocus)		
		thisform.LockScreen=.F.	
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		lParameters lLlevaFocoAGrilla
		
		
		** Parametro intocable porque a veces no puedo hacer el setfocus cuando se hace
		** un refrescarAplicacion desde otro objeto, este no puede tomar el foco sino
		** se lo debe dejar al otro objeto sin quitarselo
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Alias
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Alias+".Debe"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Alias+".Haber"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Alias+".Saldo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Alias+".TotalComprobante"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.Alias+".Comision"
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		If lLlevaFocoAGrilla
			thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
		Endif							  
		
		thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteCobradores.IrUltimo
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		For mmpp=1 to 11-thisform.FilaGrillaRelativa
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(0)
		EndFor
		thisform.tg_grid1.ActivateCell(thisform.tg_grid1.RelativeRow,8)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcobradores1.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.InteractiveChange
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcobradores1.ProgrammaticChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.InteractiveChange
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.AfterRowColChange
		LPARAMETERS nColIndex
		thisform.FilaGrillaRelativa=this.RelativeRow
		*!*	thisform.FilaGrillaAbsoluta=this.ActiveRow
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column2.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column3.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column4.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column5.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column6.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column7.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column8.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column9.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		IF this.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value=1
			thisform.oTblCobradores.Buscar(thisform.Tg_CmbCobradores1.Value)
			ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblCobradores.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
			this.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Enabled=.f.
		Else
			this.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Enabled=.t.	
		Endif
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_seleccionarcomprobantescobradores AS tg_lstselevariositems OF "tg_varios.vcx" 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="container" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"
	*<PropValue>
		Name = "tg_seleccionarcomprobantescobradores"
		Tg_listbox1.ColumnWidths = "15,30,190,60"
		Tg_listbox1.Name = "Tg_listbox1"
		Tg_3dshape1.Name = "Tg_3dshape1"
		oChkMarcaTodo.Name = "oChkMarcaTodo"
		Tg_label1.Caption = "Comprobantes"
		Tg_label1.Name = "Tg_label1"
	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cFiltro,lMarcarTodo
		Local mmpp
		
		dodefault()
		this.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu","Tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		this.AddObject("oTblCob_Docu","Tg_tabla","Cob_Docu","Clave")
		
		If Type("cFiltro")=T_CHARACTER
			this.oTblCob_Docu.Filtrar(cFiltro)
		Endif
		
		IF This.oTblParametros.Leer("OrdenNombreSelccionComprobantes")
			this.oTblVnt_Docu.FijarTag("Nombre")
			this.oTblCob_Docu.FijarTag("Nombre")		
		Endif
		
		
		
		this.oTblCob_Docu.IrPrimero
		mmpp=0
		Do while !this.oTblCob_Docu.EsEof()
			If oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",this.oTblCob_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")	,"C" ,oApp.CodSistema("Cobradores")) or !this.FiltraComprobantesEnConsultasPorPermisos
		
				mmpp=mmpp+1
				this.tg_listbox1.AddItem(space(5),mmpp,1)
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,2)=this.oTblCob_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")	
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,3)=this.oTblCob_Docu.Leer("Nombre")
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,4)="Cobradores"
				
				Dimension this.vItems[mmpp,2]
				this.vItems[mmpp,1]=this.oTblCob_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")+oApp.CodSistema("Cobradores")	
				this.vItems[mmpp,2]=.f.
			Endif
			this.oTblCob_Docu.IrSiguiente
			
		Enddo
		
		this.oTblVnt_Docu.Filtrar("Cobranza")
		this.oTblVnt_Docu.IrPrimero
		Do while !this.oTblVnt_Docu.EsEof()
			If oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",this.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")	,"C" ,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) or !this.FiltraComprobantesEnConsultasPorPermisos
		
				mmpp=mmpp+1
				this.tg_listbox1.AddItem(space(5),mmpp,1)
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,2)=this.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,3)=this.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Nombre")
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,4)="Ventas"
				
				Dimension this.vItems[mmpp,2]
				this.vItems[mmpp,1]=this.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")+oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")		
				this.vItems[mmpp,2]=.f.
		
			Endif	
			this.oTblVnt_Docu.IrSiguiente
			
		Enddo
		
		
		
		this.tg_listbox1.Listindex=1
		If lMarcarTodo
			this.MarcarTodo
		Endif
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE
